name: coding-mock-drill
title: Coding mock drill
description: Short interviewer/candidate coding block with a narrator framing how to use it.
authoring_brief: Open with narrator instructions for the second and third listen (pause and answer, then shadow). Keep the problem block realistic: clarify, approach, hand walk, pseudocode, edges, complexity.

sections.title: How to listen
sections.brief: Narrator explains the three-pass method for this episode.

sections.title: The problem
sections.brief: Interviewer states it; candidate restates and clarifies.

sections.title: Approach
sections.brief: Naive, then optimal, with the interviewer probing the why.

sections.title: Hand walk
sections.brief: Concrete trace, spoken state after each step.

sections.title: Narrated code
sections.brief: Full-word pseudocode — no symbols, no punctuation names.
